commentary.text: 90+5' David Coote is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+2' Crystal Palace fail to score from a corner as Andre Onana (Manchester United) leaps to collect the ball.
90+1' Substitution. Eberechi Eze is replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).

65' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Andre Onana pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
64' A yellow card for bad language! Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

63' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Dean Henderson makes a brilliant save! The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
61' Substitution. Joshua Zirkzee walks off the pitch and Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
60' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
57' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:5.
54' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
51' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) will deliver the corner kick.
51' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging some short passes.

45' 1 additional min. will be played.

44' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Andre Onana pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
43' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).

42' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Dean Henderson is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
39' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dean Henderson, who smothers the ball.
38' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
36' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) picks up a yellow card.
33' The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 1:4.

27' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester Utd.
22' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 32:68.
19' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.
14' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

13' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
13' The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
11' Manchester Utd quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

10' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Dean Henderson shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
8' David Coote blows his whistle and it's Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' Crystal Palace control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

3' What a great chance for Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
3' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
